about_the_game:
Welcome to "Do not respond!" — a fantastic collision of firearms and magic!

In this game, you play as an alien soldier stranded in a magical world, with only a reliable assault rifle to rely on. This world seems full of joy and wonder, but it hides a dark truth that defies perception, waiting for you to uncover it step by step.

Game Features:

  • Unique Style Fusion: Experience the contrast of bringing modern firearms into a traditional magical world, and enjoy the engaging narrative and combat design.

  • Rich Exploration Content: Traverse over 6 vast maps with distinct styles, from dark ancient ruins to eerie magical cities, each with exclusive stories and hidden challenges.

  • In-depth Progression System: Unlock and use more than 5 weapons with different functions. Through a comprehensive character leveling system and weapon crafting tree, build a custom equipment library that fits your personal tactics.

  • Intense Combat Experience: Face dozens of enemies with distinct forms and abilities, as well as multiple carefully designed level bosses, testing your strategic planning and operational reflexes.

  • Complete Collection Elements: Discover hidden collectibles scattered around the world, unlock the secret story fragments and Steam achievements behind them, and enrich your exploration dimension.
